high_level_description: The image features a navy wool pinstripe double-breasted coat dress displayed on a mannequin. The dress is designed by Catherine Walker and was worn by Princess Diana while leaving the Carlyle Hotel in New York in January 1995. The dress is showcased against a plain background, which helps to highlight its details. The coat has a classic design with gold buttons down the front and a structured silhouette. The mannequin is dressed in white gloves, adding a touch of elegance to the presentation.
